args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created a **SEV2** incident for `checkout-api` describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate 0.002.
